mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 6.0%) signal economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, depressing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which enhances corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls > 5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS falls > 50k in 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals potential monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
